exposure: low vitamin D levels at birth (cord blood 25(OH)D levels <= 75 nmol/L)
outcome: mechanical ventilation need by the end of the first week
death or mechanical ventilation need by the end of the first week (death or MV DoL7)
cohort: 109 infants with gestational age less than 29 weeks
finding: Low vitamin D levels at birth were associated with higher initial FiO2 levels and a 10-fold increased odds of death or mechanical ventilation need by the end of the first week, adjusted for gestational age.
